ref.substituent_description: A spiro carbon joins an N-Boc pyrrolidine to a five-membered lactam ring (C=O next to the spiro carbon, lactam N) that is fused to a pyridine (ring N adjacent to the carbon bearing the lactam N; 7-azaoxindole type). The lactam N carries a CH2 to a benzene ring bearing OMe para to the CH2 (4-methoxybenzyl).
ref.notes: Typeset drawing. Double bonds: lactam C=O (1), pyridine ring (3), methoxyphenyl ring (3).

wrong.substituent_description: A five-membered N-ring (pyrrolidine) bearing Boc on its N is spiro-fused at one carbon with a second five-membered ring that contains a C=O and an N and is fused to a circle-depicted benzene ring (oxindole-like). The N of that lactam ring carries a CH2 linked to a circle-depicted benzene ring bearing OCH3 para (position 4) to the CH2.
wrong.notes: Handwritten black ink. The only drawn double bond is the C=O (two parallel strokes, with the O written as a separate circle at the top). OCH3 is written with O stacked above CH3 at the lower right.

correct.substituent_description: A five-membered ring (pyrrolidine) with Boc on its ring N shares a spiro carbon with a five-membered lactam ring (C=O, then ring N) that is fused to a pyridine ring; the lactam N sits next to the fusion carbon that is adjacent to the pyridine N. The lactam N carries a CH2 linked to a circled benzene ring with OMe para (1,4) to the CH2 attachment.
correct.notes: Handwritten. The fused pyridine ring is drawn with three inner double-bond lines (Kekule style), the benzyl ring with an aromatic circle; plus one C=O, so 4 double bonds.

ref.substituent_description: Spiro carbon shared by an N-Boc pyrrolidine ring and a five-membered lactam ring (C=O, N) that is fused to a pyridine ring whose ring N is adjacent to the fusion carbon bonded to the lactam N. The lactam N carries a CH2 attached to a benzene ring bearing OMe para (1,4) to the CH2.
ref.notes: Typeset. Double bonds: one C=O, three in the pyridine ring, three in the benzene ring.

wrong.substituent_description: Spiro compound: a pyrrolidine ring with N-Boc shares its spiro carbon with a five-membered lactam ring that also contains C(=O), N and two carbons of a fused benzene ring (circle). The lactam N carries a CH2 bonded to a second benzene ring (circle) that has OCH3 at the para position relative to the CH2.
wrong.notes: OCH3 is written vertically with O above CH3. The only double bond drawn is the lactam C=O.

correct.substituent_description: A spiro carbon joins a pyrrolidine ring (ring N bearing Boc) and a five-membered lactam ring (C=O above, ring N to the right). The lactam ring is fused to a six-membered ring with one ring N (drawn at the lower right, adjacent to the carbon bonded to the lactam N). The lactam N carries a CH2 attached to a benzene ring (circle) that has OMe para to the CH2 attachment.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Spiro carbon is drawn as four lines meeting at one point (crossing look).
The C=N bond in the six-membered ring is drawn as a short inner stroke rather than a full parallel line.
correct.notes: Handwritten black pen. 4 double bonds: lactam C=O plus 3 in the pyridine ring (alternating style). The benzyl ring uses a hand-drawn circle.
